Meet the 2027 Chevrolet Equinox RS, a compact SUV that delivers practical performance and refined comfort for drivers who value both capability and everyday convenience.

- 1.5L I-4 Turbocharged engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission
- 11.3" Diagonal Advanced Color LCD Display with Chevrolet Infotainment 3
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Wireless Android Auto compatibility
- SiriusXM with 360L Trial Subscription and AM/FM radio
- Navigation System with 5G Vehicle Connectivity
- Heated driver and front passenger seats with 2-Way Power Driver Lumbar Control
- Driver 8-Way Power Seat Adjuster with Front Bucket Seats

- Auto High-beam Headlights with delay-off function
- Heated steering wheel and power door mirrors

- OnStar and Chevrolet connected services capable

This Equinox RS combines efficiency with everyday practicality. The turbocharged 1.5L engine achieves 26 city and 29 highway MPG, helping you manage fuel costs without sacrificing performance. The eight-speed automatic transmission provides smooth, responsive acceleration whether you're navigating city streets or highway drives.

The modern interior puts technology and comfort at your fingertips. Wireless smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you connected safely while driving. The 11.3-inch touchscreen display provides intuitive access to navigation, entertainment, and climate controls. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel add welcome comfort during colder months, while the power liftgate simplifies loading and unloading cargo.

Safety and control are built into every drive. The turbocharged performance is balanced by Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and a four-wheel independent suspension that handles various road conditions confidently. Dual front airbags and side impact airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection, complemented by OnStar emergency communication services and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

This black Equinox RS is finished with 19" aluminum wheels and body-color bumpers that give it a polished appearance. The practical design accommodates your lifestyle with split-folding rear seats, allowing you to reconfigure cargo space to suit your needs. Rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights add convenience features that adapt to changing conditions.

The 2027 Chevrolet Equinox RS delivers straightforward value for drivers who want a dependable SUV with modern conveniences and solid engineering. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand.
